verdict.rationale: Greptile's own CLI is documented for CI use: you authenticate with an API key and run `greptile review` non-interactively. A `--agent` flag emits machine-consumable raw text, and the product also reviews every PR automatically with no human in the loop. Missing for 10: documented CI pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions config), exit-code or merge-gating behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: For CI or self-hosted deployments, use an API key: export GREPTILE_API_KEY=... greptile review
`greptile review --agent` outputs every greptile catch as raw text with a suggested fix for your agent to apply.
Run `greptile review`, get a review of the feature branch diff in 60 seconds.
Greptile is an AI code review agent that automatically reviews every pull request with complete understanding of your codebase.
